title: Session: 2.30.0 approved production deploys over SSH
objective: 2.30.0 adds the Deploy production workflow and ops/deploy.sh: production deploys run from GitHub after the owner approves them, over one restricted SSH key. The bot is unchanged: no migration, no command change. Deploys stay off until DEPLOY_ENABLED is set.
user: Before the PR merges: create the production environment (you as the only reviewer, self-review allowed, no admin bypass, main only) and notify (main only). Leave DEPLOY_ENABLED unset.

After the merge: deploy 2.30.0 to production by hand (a restart), install jq on the host, add the deploy key and its restricted authorized_keys line, set DEPLOY_HOST and DEPLOY_KNOWN_HOSTS, add the Pushover secrets, then set DEPLOY_ENABLED=true.
First run: dispatch Deploy production with version=2.30.0 and approve it; expect already live, commands registered and one Pushover message.
Still open from 2.29.0's plan: /officer revoke, then /officer reset on a rank officer, each gives one 'Member status changes' post.
assistant: Prepare the owner's setup commands (docs/HOSTING.md, Automated deploys); never approve, reject or bypass a deployment, and never hold the deploy key.
Record the first automated runs in docs/VERIFICATION.md.
bot: Keep running 2.29.0 on schema 010 until the owner deploys 2.30.0; it changes no running code.
Post this responsibility-separated session plan in #chat.
